# Top 10 on campus and off campus (generated by src/campus.py)

On campus means inside, or within 5 m of, the OpenStreetMap boundary of the University of Florida. Each group is ranked with the same score as the main ranking.

- 103 of 971 stops are on campus and 868 are off campus.
- Off-campus stops carry 74 percent of weekday bus visits.
- Of the visits at stops with no known shelter, 79 percent are off campus.
- Of the main top 20, 19 are on campus and 1 are off campus.
